positive_terms: Explanation of any objective or plans (CapEx, CapEx plans, OpEx) for aligning economic activities (revenues, CapEx, OpEx) with criteria established in Commission Delegated Regulation 2021/2139
经济活动与分类法对齐计划

Explanation of any objective or plans (CapEx, CapEx plans, OpEx) for aligning economic activities (revenues, CapEx, OpEx) with criteria established in Commission Delegated Regulation 2021/2139。经济活动与分类法对齐计划。计划、资源、基准适用情况与实施进展分别举证；承诺不等于已批准或已实现。煤、油、气支出不可互换。
